title: Confirmatory BugsInPy re-run under arm-side apply-clean patch emission
class: new prospective confirmatory study with new model dispatch; NOT a re-analysis of E30-R11
question: With patches canonicalized at emission so they actually apply, do the four registered solver arms separate on real BugsInPy repair, on the registered failing-test endpoint and on the full-regression critical-failure endpoint?

why_this_study_exists.confound: E30-R11's confirmatory null was measured through a defective interface. PC-R6 established that NONE_PATCH_NOT_APPLIED accounts for 78-83% of evaluations per arm on E30-R11's frozen proposals, and the frozen lane recorded 311/480 patch-apply rc=128. E70-GC1 localized the entire raw-endpoint variance between arms to unified-diff hunk-header miscounting (success_iff_header_unchanged = true for all four arms; the syntax-normalized endpoint was 24/24 for every arm). E70-GC2 found raw header-exact success 0/16 at every difficulty rung, 48/48 diffs needing canonicalization.
why_this_study_exists.fix: PR #168 (merge 8945cec) added src/orion_v2/patch_emission.py and wired it into scripts/orion_claude_arms.py and scripts/orion_codex_arms.py, canonicalizing at emission. A CI gate (patch-emission-interface) asserts the emission path stays gold-blind and non-mutating.
why_this_study_exists.consequence: Roughly four in five E30-R11 evaluations never tested a repair. The registered question has therefore never been asked under a working interface. R12 asks it.

changed: the full-regression co-primary endpoint is checkable from the start

substrate.task_identity_source: E30-R11 prepared/frozen_tasks.json (same 40 ids, same selection policy, re-materialized under the same pinned commit and per-project runtimes)

pinned_pool_for_scale_up.counted_on: inputs/BugsInPy-base/projects/*/bugs, numeric ids only, all carrying bug.info

model_binding.assertion: every call reads data['model'] from the response body and raises ServedModelMismatch unless it equals ORION_ARM_SERVED_MODEL exactly; the exception is re-raised out of run_arm rather than being folded into an EXECUTION_FAILED_MODEL_RESPONSE envelope, so the arm exits non-zero
model_binding.substrate_alert: the z.ai Anthropic-compatible endpoint silently serves glm-5.3 for a glm-5.2 request (verified live 2026-09-02: requested glm-5.2 -> served 'glm-5.3'; requested glm-5.3 -> served 'glm-5.3'). Pinning the requested id is not sufficient; the served id is what is asserted.
model_binding.per_envelope_record: resource_receipt.served_model_ids (sorted unique list over the envelope's calls)
model_binding.post_hoc_homogeneity_assertion: the analysis refuses to compute any contrast unless every response envelope in both arms records exactly one served model id and all of them are identical across the whole campaign
model_binding.codex_channel: not used by this study; the codex CLI channel is unaffected by the substitution
model_binding.stated_limitation: E30-R11's response envelopes record no served model id and its campaign env requested glm-5.2, which this endpoint substitutes. R11's served model is therefore inferred, not verified, and R12-vs-R11 cross-study comparison is descriptive only. Within R12 every contrast is served-model homogeneous by assertion.

E1_PRIMARY.name: registered_failing_test_fixed
E1_PRIMARY.definition: the task's registered failing test passes after the arm's patch is applied and the workspace compiles, under the frozen per-project runtime
E1_PRIMARY.unit: task, after within-task majority aggregation over the 3 repetitions

E2_CO_PRIMARY.name: any_critical_new_failure
E2_CO_PRIMARY.definition: at least one test passing in the baseline suite fails after the arm's patch is applied; derived exactly as PC-R6 section 3 derives critical_new_failure_count
E2_CO_PRIMARY.unit: task, after within-task majority aggregation over the 3 repetitions
E2_CO_PRIMARY.direction: non-inferiority, F2 must not exceed F0 by more than 0.02
E2_CO_PRIMARY.companion: full_regression_suite_passed = 1 iff the registered failing test passes AND critical_new_failure_count == 0
E2_CO_PRIMARY.registered_in: ORION_REAL_PROBLEM_CONFIRMATORY_SUITE_V1.json primary_outcomes[1..2]; margin fixed pre-outcome in ORION_REAL_PROBLEM_ANALYSIS_PLAN_V1.md section 7

D1_REGISTERED_DIAGNOSTIC.name: patch_apply_rate
D1_REGISTERED_DIAGNOSTIC.definition: the proportion of an arm's 120 evaluations whose patch application succeeds (git apply rc == 0)
D1_REGISTERED_DIAGNOSTIC.unit: evaluation (not task); reported per arm with an exact binomial interval
D1_REGISTERED_DIAGNOSTIC.purpose: make the effect of the emission fix measurable rather than assumed

historical_comparator.source: PC-R6 PC_R6_FULLREG_ROLLUP_V1 cell e30r11, measured by the same evaluator code on E30-R11's frozen proposals
historical_comparator.why_not_the_frozen_lane_311_of_480: only the PC-R6 evaluator is the same code as R12's evaluator; the frozen lane's rc=128 count is a different application path and is not an apples-to-apples comparator

D1_REGISTERED_DIAGNOSTIC.directional_prediction_registered_pre_di: every arm's apply-FAIL rate in R12 falls below its PC-R6 comparator; the pre-registered success criterion for the fix is that every arm's apply-fail rate is below 0.40
D1_REGISTERED_DIAGNOSTIC.not_a_success_endpoint: D1 cannot support any claim about arm separation or repair quality

task_dispositions_registered_pre_dispatc.rule: dispositions are keyed to machine-detected, arm-independent substrate condition codes emitted by the baseline pass, never to task names or to observed arm outcomes; applying them after seeing R12 outcomes would be criterion_mutation, a registered hard failure

conditions.meaning: the baseline suite for the task contains no test that passes before patching, so no test can become a new failure
conditions.E2: EXCLUDE WITH COUNT from every E2 contrast and report the excluded ids

conditions.meaning: the registered failing test is order-dependent and already fails inside the full-module suite run, so full_regression_suite_passed is ill-defined for it
conditions.E1: RETAIN in the denominator (E1 runs the registered test binding, not the module suite)
conditions.E2: RETAIN for any_critical_new_failure; record full_regression_suite_passed as CANNOT_CHECK

conditions.meaning: the fixed commit adds a fixture the BugsInPy checkout never copies, so no source-only patch can flip the registered test
conditions.E1: RETAIN in the primary denominator (arm-independent and concordant-negative by construction, so it carries no discordant information and cannot bias a paired contrast); ALSO report a pre-registered sensitivity denominator of 39 excluding it
conditions.detection: this one is not machine-detectable from the baseline pass; it is carried as a named pre-outcome substrate finding from PC-R6 GR0(b) and is applied only if the R12 GR0(b) gold control reproduces the same failure for the same task

statistics.aggregation: within task/arm over the 3 reps by majority, exactly as E60 and PC-R6; a task/arm cell with no checkable rep is None and is excluded from every paired contrast with no imputation
statistics.paired_test: exact two-sided McNemar / sign-binomial on task-level discordant pairs
statistics.intervals: paired task bootstrap, 10000 draws, PROJECT-stratified, seed 20260902

E2_family.correction: Holm step-down, alpha 0.05, computed independently of the E1 family

multiplicity.note: two separate Holm families of three, one per endpoint, registered here so the co-primary's multiplicity is not ambiguous after the fact

power_note.generator: e30_r12_power_note.py (pure arithmetic, exact enumeration, no outcome input)
power_note.plain_statement: 40 tasks CANNOT detect a plausible effect. At n=40 the exact test cannot reject at any effect size unless at least 7 tasks are discordant in the same direction, i.e. a risk difference of at least 0.175; power against the programme's own registered 5-percentage-point minimum important difference is 1-2%. Detecting 5 pp at 80% power needs 430 tasks in the most favourable discordance regime and 863-1708 in plausible ones. BugsInPy at the pinned commit contains 501 numeric bugs in total and 295 within the 8 registered projects, so the registered 5 pp MID is NOT attainable on this benchmark at any task count under this test, and is attainable at psi=0.10 only by consuming most of the benchmark.
power_note.consequence_for_r12: R12 is registered as an ESTIMATION AND DIAGNOSTIC study at n=40, comparable to E30-R11, not as a powered superiority test. Failure to reject is the expected outcome under any effect smaller than 0.175 and must never be reported as evidence of equivalence.

proposed_scale_up_if_a_powered_test_is_e.verdict: even the whole benchmark is underpowered for 5 pp at psi >= 0.20; a powered confirmatory test of the registered MID requires either a materially larger real-problem substrate than BugsInPy or a registered MID raised to what n=40 (>= 0.175) or n=295 (see the note generator) can actually detect. Raising the MID after seeing outcomes is prohibited; it may only be re-registered for a future study before dispatch.

power_note.repetitions_tradeoff: 3 repetitions match E30-R11 and satisfy the suite's minimum_stochastic_repetitions. E30-R11 documented 2-6 tasks per arm flipping success across reps, so 5 reps would reduce task-level misclassification. Repetitions buy reliability, not power: the test is on tasks, so the arithmetic floor of 7 discordant tasks is unchanged. R12 stays at 3.

evaluation_lane.runner: e30_r12_fullreg_eval.py -- registers an e30r12 cell on the PC-R6 evaluator and delegates; the PC-R6 evaluator is IMPORTED, not forked, so apply rates are computed by literally the same code that produced the D1 comparator
evaluation_lane.campaign_layout_required: run/confirmatory-r{1,2,3}/{responses,evaluations}/<ARM>/<task_id>.json plus frozen_tasks.json, which is what scripts/run_orion_real_problem_suite.py already produces

gates.name: LANE_SELF_CONSISTENCY
gates.statement: the full-regression lane's registered-failing-test result reproduces the campaign's own frozen-lane (e30_r11_arm_eval_frozen_lane.py) native_success vector bit-exactly for all 480 evaluations
gates.why_it_differs_from_pc_r6: PC-R6's GR0(a) checked against a pre-existing frozen vector; R12 has no prior vector, so R12 runs BOTH evaluators over its own 480 proposals and requires them to agree. Disagreement is a lane defect: halt, receipt, re-freeze.

gates.name: GOLD_KNOWN_ANSWER_CONTROL
gates.statement: on a frozen 5-task subset (one per project where available) the task's gold patch flips the registered failing test to passing AND yields critical_new_failure_count == 0 under the same suite definition
gates.gold_access: this stage and only this stage reads gold patches; its records are marked gold_or_fixed_solution_accessed = true and it runs after all arm responses are written

gates.name: SERVED_MODEL_HOMOGENEITY
gates.statement: every one of the 480 response envelopes records exactly one served model id and all 480 are identical and equal to the frozen served model

gates.name: APPLY_RATE_DIAGNOSTIC
gates.statement: D1: every arm's patch-apply FAIL rate is below 0.40, and below its PC-R6 comparator
gates.interpretation: GR1 measures whether the emission fix worked. GR1 failing does not invalidate E1/E2; it means R12 measured a still-broken interface and must say so.

gates.name: PRIMARY_SEPARATION
gates.statement: E1: any of the three F2-vs-control contrasts rejects at Holm-adjusted alpha 0.05
gates.note: given the power note, non-rejection is the expected outcome and is not evidence of equivalence

gates.name: CRITICAL_NON_INFERIORITY
gates.statement: E2: upper bound of the one-sided 97.5% CI for RD(any_critical_new_failure: F2 - F0) <= 0.02
gates.non_compensatory: an E1 gain cannot offset a GR3 failure (analysis plan section 6)

routing_preregistered.case: GR0a or GR0b or GR0c fails
routing_preregistered.terminal: LANE_DEFECT: halt, receipt, re-freeze; no endpoint is read

INTERFACE_STILL_BROKEN: R12 reports that emission-side canonicalization did not materially raise the apply rate; E1/E2 are reported with the measured apply rate attached to every number, and the study does not claim to have tested repair

routing_preregistered.case: GR1 passes, GR2 null, GR3 passes
routing_preregistered.terminal: NO_ARM_SEPARATION under a working interface, tail-safe at the registered margin. This is an EXPECTED AND LEGITIMATE TERMINAL, not a failure of the study. It says the metabolic architecture does not beat its controls on real BugsInPy repair once patches actually apply, at a task count that could only have detected a very large effect.

routing_preregistered.case: GR1 passes, GR2 null, and F0_PARENT_FEDERATION is numerically at or above F2 on E1
routing_preregistered.terminal: PARENT_SUFFICIENT: the strongest native parent is sufficient on this substrate; a valid terminal that closes the F2-superiority line on real debugging

routing_preregistered.case: GR1 passes, GR2 rejects in F2's favour, GR3 passes
routing_preregistered.terminal: FIRST_REGISTERED_POSITIVE on real-problem repair; requires an independent replication under a new identity before any paper claim
F2_HARMFUL on this substrate; reported as plainly as a positive
CRITICAL_REGRESSION: non-compensatory. No F2 advantage of any size may be claimed from this cell.

r12_may_not: revise, re-score, re-analyze or reinterpret E30-R11's, E60's or PC-R6's endpoints
present itself as a correction of E30-R11
use the apply-rate diagnostic to re-read E30-R11's null as anything other than what E30-R11's own terminal receipt states
change any endpoint, margin, family, disposition rule or suite definition after the first response is written
drop a task after observing which arm fails on it
re-roll a completed model response; only EXECUTION_FAILED_MODEL_RESPONSE envelopes (which contain no model output) may be re-dispatched, exactly as E30-R11's guarded redispatch did
no_rescue_clause.a_null_is_a_result: if the arms still do not separate once patches apply, that is a real and important result and is reported as plainly as a positive would be

custody.authorization_object: E30_R12_COORDINATOR_AUTHORIZATION.json with human_written = true, the verbatim operator instruction, and acknowledged_design_sha256 == sha256 of this JSON; absent at design freeze, written before dispatch
custody.gold_blindness: arms read only the gold-blind solver workspace; gold patches are read only by GR0b, after all responses are written

routing_precedence_note: Evaluated in this order; the first matching case is the terminal. Hard-gate and adverse terminals precede favourable ones, and PARENT_SUFFICIENT precedes NO_ARM_SEPARATION because it is the more specific description of the same state.

execution_lane_contract.why_registered: E30-R11 diagnosed two execution-lane failure signatures that produce EXECUTION_FAILED_MODEL_RESPONSE envelopes containing no model output, and repaired both. One repair (the decoder tolerance) was campaign-local and never reached main, so R12 would silently inherit the defect; the other (a token-budget raise on envelope failures) was a procedure, not code. Both are registered here BEFORE dispatch so R12's execution lane is identical to R11's terminal one by declaration rather than by improvisation mid-run.

signature_1_strict_parse_reject.mechanism: the model emits literal newlines inside JSON string values; json.loads with the default strict=True rejects them although strict=False decodes the identical object
signature_1_strict_parse_reject.class: decoder tolerance -- same bytes, same object; prompts, schema, model, temperature, arm structure and scoring untouched

signature_2_truncation_starved.mechanism: the served model emits a thinking block counted inside max_tokens; on the largest tasks the thinking consumes the whole per-call budget before the required JSON closes (stop_reason=max_tokens, zero visible text)

primary_budget.note: identical to the budget under which 466 of E30-R11's 480 envelopes completed, so R12's arms are resourced as R11's were

escalated_budget.note: 12000 per call on the 3-call arms; E30-R11's registered execution-resource raise, applied ONLY to envelopes that carry no model output
escalated_budget.why_pass_3: The starvation is deterministic at temperature 0, not noise: a pre-dispatch smoke call on the exact channel returned output_tokens pinned exactly at the 6000 cap with zero visible text, and the identical request at 36000 used 3669. Passes at the primary budget beyond the first few therefore re-truncate the same cells -- E30-R11's own loop plateaued at 13 stuck cells and only the budget raise cleared them. Two full passes at the primary budget preserve R11's resourcing for every envelope that can complete there; the raise then applies only to envelopes carrying no model output. Fixed here, before authorization; changing it afterwards would be criterion drift.

signature_2_truncation_starved.class: execution-resource raise on envelope failure; NOT resampling -- a COMPLETED_PROPOSAL_ONLY response is never re-rolled (no-rescue clause)
signature_2_truncation_starved.within_study_symmetry: The budget policy is identical across arms, so it cannot bias a paired contrast. Arms do starve at different rates because the total budget is divided by the arm's call count (SIMPLE_DIRECT 1 call, F2 and F0 3 calls) -- exactly as in E30-R11 -- but an envelope failure is a MISSING datum, not a failure outcome, so rescuing more of them reduces missingness rather than favouring an arm.

reported_in_the_receipt: envelopes completed at the primary budget
envelopes never completed, by failure signature
actual wall-clock and model-call counts per arm (D1's comparator came from a different lane's compute)
